observations.title: No read-only script path for exhaustive scans (medium)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Limitation.
- **Scenario:** An agent needs one query over hundreds of assets, such as all referencers in a folder or all widget Blueprints that contain a given widget class.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed by two subagents.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Call the engine script tool with a script that only reads the asset registry.
  2. Read the result.
- **Observed:** The TurboMCP safety filter refused the script tool. The safety filter does not offer a read-only mode.
- **Expected:** A read-only script path, or batch read tools that cover the same need (user expectation).
- **Impact:** Blocked workflow. The widget inventory stayed partial. The reference walk took about one hour through an external helper.
- **State after:** No change to assets.
- **Workaround:** An external helper called the MCP endpoint once per asset. It worked but was slow.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** A read-only script mode with no save and no map load, or the batch tools in section 4.

observations.title: A tool policy error on every read call in one subagent (medium)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Defect.
- **Scenario:** Six subagents used the read toolset in the same period.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed once, in one subagent.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Call read tools from one subagent while other subagents call the same toolset.
  2. Read the error.
- **Observed:** Every read call from that subagent returned an error that the tool policy was unavailable and that the editor needed a restart. The other subagents worked in the same period. The editor was not restarted.
- **Expected:** The same result for the same calls, or an error that names the real problem (user expectation).
- **Impact:** That subagent used the engine Blueprint text reader. It lost node IDs and pin names.
- **State after:** The editor kept working for the other subagents.
- **Workaround:** Engine readers. They worked with less detail.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** An error that states which tool name or policy failed, without a restart advice when the editor is healthy.

observations.title: Reads stop at 60 rows with no paging (medium)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Limitation.
- **Scenario:** A reference list and a key list longer than 60 entries.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed in this session; also seen before for tables.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Read an asset with more than 60 referencers or entries.
  2. Look for a next page.
- **Observed:** The output stopped at 60 entries. No paging argument was offered. One keyboard icon list was cut.
- **Expected:** Paging or a full count (user expectation).
- **Impact:** Missing data in the audit.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** None observed.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** A page argument and a total count.

observations.title: Shared scratch folder between subagents (low)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Usability (client context, not the plugin).
- **Scenario:** Several subagents wrote helper scripts into one scratch folder.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed once.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Run several subagents that write helper files with the same names.
- **Observed:** One subagent overwrote the helper file of another.
- **Expected:** Separate folders per subagent (user expectation).
- **Impact:** One subagent renamed its files and continued.
- **State after:** No asset impact.
- **Workaround:** File name prefixes per subagent. It worked.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** None for the plugin.

observations.title: One asset per call, about 2 seconds per call (medium)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Limitation.
- **Scenario:** About 690 seed assets, and an upward walk of referencers to find game roots.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed, about 1600 calls.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Read referencers for one asset.
  2. Repeat for every seed and for each referencer.
- **Observed:** Each call took about 2 seconds. The full walk took about one hour.
- **Expected:** A batch or folder query with a depth limit (user expectation).
- **Impact:** About one hour of wait for one audit step.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** An external helper loop. It worked.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** See FT-166.

observations.title: Hard and soft references are not separated (low)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Limitation.
- **Scenario:** Classify assets as used or orphan.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Read the referencers of an asset.
- **Observed:** The output did not say if a reference was hard or soft.
- **Expected:** A reference kind per entry (user expectation).
- **Impact:** The orphan classification needs manual checks.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** None observed.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** Add the reference kind.

observations.title: Referencers that no longer exist on disk (low)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Usability.
- **Scenario:** Referencer lists of input assets.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed, 6 packages.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Read referencers, then look for those packages.
- **Observed:** Six listed referencers were not on disk.
- **Expected:** A flag for packages that do not exist (user expectation).
- **Impact:** False users in the audit until checked by hand.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** Manual file check. It worked.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** Mark missing packages.

observations.title: References were reliable over about 1600 calls (positive)
observations.observation:
- **Scenario:** Long reference walk.
- **Observed:** No failed call was reported over about 1600 calls.

observations.title: The path argument was ignored (medium)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Defect.
- **Scenario:** Search inside one content folder.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed once.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Search with a folder path and a query.
- **Observed:** The tool returned about 1049 hits from the whole project.
- **Expected:** Hits inside the folder only (user expectation).
- **Impact:** Large output, manual filter.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** The engine asset finder. It worked.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** Respect the path, or say that it is not supported.

observations.title: A schema error when the query is outside the arguments object (low)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Usability.
- **Scenario:** A client sent the query as a top-level field.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed once.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Call the tool with the query outside the arguments object.
- **Observed:** The error said that the input parameters were empty.
- **Expected:** An error that names the misplaced field (user expectation).
- **Impact:** One retry.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** Put the query inside the arguments object. It worked.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** A clearer error.

observations.title: One asset per call (medium)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Limitation.
- **Scenario:** Read the same few properties on about 45 input actions.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Read the properties of one asset.
  2. Repeat for each asset.
- **Observed:** 45 calls for 45 assets.
- **Expected:** Several assets and named properties in one call (user expectation).
- **Impact:** Slow reads and large context use.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** One call per asset. It worked.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** See FT-170.

observations.title: Blueprint class defaults are refused (medium)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Limitation.
- **Scenario:** Read the defaults of Blueprint data classes and widget array defaults.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed several times.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Read a property of a Blueprint class default object.
- **Observed:** The tool refused. The engine fallback returned about 15 to 20 KB for one icon map.
- **Expected:** Class default reads with a property filter (user expectation).
- **Impact:** Large outputs; key lists were partly inferred.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** Engine default-object reader plus property reader. It worked but was verbose.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** Support class defaults, with keys-only output for maps.

observations.title: Owned subobjects are expanded (positive)
observations.observation:
- **Scenario:** Input actions with nested settings objects.
- **Observed:** Nested settings and metadata were shown in full.

observations.title: Fallback to the manifest at medium token budgets (medium)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Limitation.
- **Scenario:** Load a widget Blueprint with a token budget from 6000 to 22000.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed several times.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Load the Blueprint with a medium budget.
- **Observed:** The output often had the manifest only, without signatures.
- **Expected:** A partial body or a clear note of what is cut (user expectation).
- **Impact:** One extra call per graph.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** Graph load per graph. It worked.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** Return signatures before bodies.

observations.title: Read-only noise for some node kinds (low)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Usability.
- **Scenario:** Graphs with persistent-frame variable sets and bound event calls.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Load a graph with these node kinds.
- **Observed:** These nodes printed as "no node type ID" errors.
- **Expected:** No error in a read-only call (user expectation).
- **Impact:** Noise only.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** None needed.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** Print these nodes as read-only.

observations.title: A malformed link on a self pin (low)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Defect.
- **Scenario:** A construction graph that sets text on a widget.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed once.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Load the graph.
- **Observed:** The self pin of a set text call was reported as a malformed link.
- **Expected:** A normal link (user expectation).
- **Impact:** Doubt about the graph.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** None observed.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** None.

observations.title: Graph load per graph worked (positive)
observations.observation:
- **Scenario:** Remap menu graphs.
- **Observed:** Per-graph loads gave full call order where the full Blueprint load fell back.

observations.title: Search covers one asset only (medium)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Limitation.
- **Scenario:** Find every call of one function in a content folder.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Search for a function name without an asset.
- **Observed:** The tool searches one asset per call. No folder or project scope exists.
- **Expected:** A folder or project scope (user expectation).
- **Impact:** The audit could not prove that no other caller exists.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** Searches in likely assets only. Not exhaustive.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** See FT-168.

observations.title: Separator in a query found nothing (low)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Usability.
- **Scenario:** One query with several alternative words.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Search with words separated by a vertical bar.
- **Observed:** No hit. Words are matched together on one node.
- **Expected:** An OR mode (user expectation).
- **Impact:** One call per word.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** One call per word. It worked.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** An OR mode.

observations.title: Node context does not accept the node path printed by node find (low)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Usability.
- **Scenario:** Chain node find and node context.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Copy the node path from node find into node context.
- **Observed:** Refused. Node context needs a graph name and a short node ID.
- **Expected:** The same identifier in both tools (user expectation).
- **Impact:** Manual split of the identifier.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** Pass graph name and short ID. It worked.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** Accept the full path.

observations.title: Instance overrides are not shown (medium)
observations.observation:
- **Type:** Limitation.
- **Scenario:** A widget with several child instances that set an icon texture each.
- **Reproduction status:** Observed.
- **Steps to reproduce:**
  1. Read the widget tree.
  2. Look for the instance values.
- **Observed:** The tree did not show the values set on each instance.
- **Expected:** Instance overrides in the tree (user expectation).
- **Impact:** One engine property call per instance.
- **State after:** No change.
- **Workaround:** Engine property reader per instance. It worked.
- **Cause:** The cause is not confirmed.
- **Proposed behavior:** List overridden properties per instance.
